subject: *: Truncate partition with global index improvement (#55831)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for runtime impact in planner/executor/table/tablecodec. Changes primarily add global-index overwrite handling during TRUNCATE PARTITION delete-reorg, ensure dropped/truncated partitions are representable in table layer for cleanup, and make the planner avoid point-get via global index during partition mid-states; no remaining Blocker/High issues found.
